awarded_by: Initiative Neue Soziale Marktwirtschaft (INSM) and Frankfurter Allgemeine Sonntagszeitung
detail: Award of the Initiative Neue Soziale Marktwirtschaft (INSM), a business lobby organisation whose supporters' association Merz belonged to from 2005 to 2014, together with the Sunday edition of the FAZ.
Prize for contributions to the relationship between politics and language, awarded at irregular intervals; earlier laureates include Willy Brandt and Helmut Schmidt.

honor: Orden wider den tierischen Ernst (Order Against Deadly Seriousness)
detail: Carnival order awarded for his campaign against German tax bureaucracy. His acceptance speech drew attention when it emerged that parts of it had been taken from a fictional interview published by Der Spiegel.

awarded_by: Federation of German-American Clubs (Verband der Deutsch-Amerikanischen Clubs)
detail: Medal for outstanding contributions to German-American friendship, presented on German-American Day; awarded while he chaired the Atlantik-Brücke.
